info.title: MoEngage Content Block API
info.description:
Content blocks allow marketers to reuse the same content across multiple campaigns. For example, a block might be a repeatedly used header, footer, or designed call-to-action button.


This API enables you to fetch, create, and update content blocks on your MoEngage dashboard. [Read more about Content blocks in MoEngage](/user-guide/content/content-blocks/content-blocks).

tags.name: Content Blocks
tags.description: Use these operations to programmatically fetch, create, and update reusable content blocks.

dc.description: The 'dc' in the API Endpoint URL refers to the MoEngage Data Center (DC). MoEngage hosts each customer in a different DC. You can find your DC number and replace the value of 'dc' in the URL by referring to the DC and API endpoint mapping [here](/api/introduction#data-centers). Your MoEngage Data Center (DC) can be 01, 02, 03, 04, 05, 06, or 101.

post.description:
This API creates a content block in MoEngage.

Use the `source` field in the request body to specify the communication type for the content block:
- `"source": "CAMPAIGNS"`: Creates a content block for use in MoEngage campaigns.
- `"source": "INFORM"`: Creates a content block for use in Inform alerts.

parameters.name: MOE-APPKEY
parameters.description: This is the Workspace ID of your MoEngage account that must be passed with the request. You can find it in the MoEngage dashboard at **Settings** > **Account** > **APIs** > **Workspace ID (earlier app id)**.

requestBody.description: The details of the content block to be created.

put.description:
This API updates the content blocks in MoEngage.

<Note>Updates are not always instant. For large content blocks, the updated state can take up to ~30 minutes to propagate to active event-triggered and flow sends. Small content blocks typically refresh near-instantly.</Note>

parameters.description: This is the Workspace ID of your MoEngage account that must be passed with the request. You can find it in the MoEngage dashboard at **Settings** > **Account** > **APIs** > **Workspace ID (earlier app id)**.

requestBody.description: The updated details for the content block.

BasicAuth.description:
Authentication is done via Basic Auth. This requires a base64-encoded string of your credentials in the format 'username:password'.

- **Username**: Use your MoEngage workspace ID (also known as the App ID). You can find it in the MoEngage dashboard at **Settings** > **Account** > **APIs** > **Workspace ID (earlier app id)**.
- **Password**: Use your API Key, which you can find within the **Campaign report/Business events/Custom templates/Catalog API/Inform Report** tile.

For more information on authentication and getting your credentials, refer [here](https://www.moengage.com/docs/api/introduction#getting-your-credentials).

label.description: Label to uniquely identify your content block

status.description: Shows the status of the content block

raw_content.description:
Content of the content block.
<Note>`ContentApi.*` Jinja calls are not supported in `raw_content`. Using them will cause the request to fail with a `400` error.</Note>

content_type.description: Type of the content block - HTML/ Plain Text

created_by.description: Email id of the user who is creating the content block

tag_ids.description: Tags associated with the content block

team_ids.description:
Teams for which the content block should be available. Passing team id is mandatory if you are using multiple teams.
<Note>Pass the internal team ID (for example, `69fb3d7d66ea00bdb35da08e`), not the team's display name. For more information, refer to [Teams](/user-guide/settings/account/team-management/teams-in-moengage).</Note>

content_block_used.description:
In case, you are using nested content blocks, provide the names of the other content blocks used in this content block.
<Note>If you are not using nested content blocks, you can pass this as an empty array: `content_block_used : []`</Note>

images_used.description: An image referenced within the content block.

source.description:
Communication type for the content block. Supported values are:
* `CAMPAIGNS`: Creates a content block for use in MoEngage campaigns.
* `INFORM`: Creates a content block for use in Inform alerts.
<Note>You cannot change the communication type after the content block is created.</Note>

content_json.description:
Structured JSON representation of the content block's content, as used by the drag-and-drop builder on the MoEngage dashboard.
<Note>This field is optional and currently populated by the MoEngage dashboard for content blocks built visually. It is not required when creating a content block via this API using `raw_content`.</Note>

id.description: ID of the content block that you want to update

status.description: Status of the content block - DRAFT/ACTIVE

content_type.description:
Type of the content block, set at creation time.
<Note>`content_type` cannot be changed via this API. Including a different value in an update request fails with a `400` error: "Changing content type is not supported in update api".</Note>

raw_content.description:
Content of the content block.
<Note>`ContentApi.*` Jinja calls are not supported in `raw_content`. Using them will cause the request to fail with a `400` error.</Note>

updated_by.description: Email id of the user who is updating the content block

tag_ids.description: Tags associated to the content block

team_ids.description:
Teams for which the content block should be available. Passing team id is mandatory if you are using multiple Teams.
<Note>Pass the internal team ID (for example, `69fb3d7d66ea00bdb35da08e`), not the team's display name. For more information, refer to [Teams](/user-guide/settings/account/team-management/teams-in-moengage).</Note>

content_block_used.description:
In case, you are using nested content blocks, provide the names of the other content blocks used in this content block.
<Note>If you are not using nested content blocks, you can pass this as an empty array: `content_block_used : []`</Note>

images_used.description: An image referenced within the content block.

content_json.description:
Structured JSON representation of the content block's content, as used by the drag-and-drop builder on the MoEngage dashboard.
<Note>This field is optional and currently populated by the MoEngage dashboard for content blocks built visually. It is not required when creating a content block via this API using `raw_content`.</Note>

ids.description: Comma-separated list of the content block ids

is_raw_content_required.description:
Boolean Flag used to control whether we need to show raw content or not.
* `True`: Returns Non-Personalized content which was given during creation. * `False`: Does not return Personalized content

filters.description:
A set of filters to apply to the search.
<Note>You can send empty filters if you want all the content blocks: `{ "filters" : {} }`</Note>

content_type.description: Type of the content block - HTML/Text

team_ids.description:
IDs of the teams for which the content block is enabled. This is only applicable to the accounts where Teams is enabled.
<Note>Pass the internal team ID (for example, `69fb3d7d66ea00bdb35da08e`), not the team's display name. For more information, refer to [Teams](/user-guide/settings/account/team-management/teams-in-moengage).</Note>

status.description:
Status of the content block.
<Note>`ARCHIVED` is not a valid status value; filtering by it returns an empty result set. Valid values are `DRAFT`, `ACTIVE`, `DELETING`, and `DELETED`.</Note>
